faqs.question: In which branches is MACEE active ?
faqs.answer: We are active is different branches like: High Tech, Finance and Banking, Consultancy, Oil & Gas, Utility and Energy, Government, Pharma, eCommerce and more

faqs.question: What expertise does MACEE mostly recruit for ?
faqs.answer:
Software Development: .NET, C / C++ / C#, JAVA, Python

BI & Data: Spark, MSBI, PowerBI, Informatica PowerCenter, AI, ML, Kafka, ETL, Datavault, Tableau, Hadoop

Project Management: PMO, Program Manager

Cloud: AWS, Azure, Kubernetes

Security: CISM, CISSP, CISO, Cyber Security, IAM, RBAC, DLP, CyberArk, Third Party Risk, Network, Infrastructure

Finance Risk Management: Regulatory reporting, AML, FEC, KYC, Modelling, QRM, Audit, Trading, Markets, Corep, Finrep, EMIR

faqs.question: Why do business with MACEE ?
faqs.answer: We have for almost every situation a solution, more than 30 years of experience in contracting and (IT) recruitment business so we have a broad international network, in debt experience and knowledge of IT expertise and development in last years. Doing business with us we help and service on a personal way, with us you’re not a number.

faqs.question: What kind of services can MACEE provide ?
faqs.answer:
• Helping with the application for the 30% tax benefit ruling
• Visa application for partner and children
• Recruitment for temporary projects and permanent positions

faqs.question: What kind of contracts can MACEE provide ?
faqs.answer:
• Secondment
• Freelance / ZZP
• Permanent positions at clients of MACEE
• Contract to perm (Deta-Vast)

faqs.question: Can MACEE sponsor my work Visa ?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can be your sponsor for your work Visa when you have a project with a client. MACEE is an official IND registered company.

faqs.question: What kind of roles and projects does MACEE handle for her clients ?
faqs.answer: We serve multiple clients in multiple branches, most projects are IT / Business related and you can think within; Infrastructure, Network, Software Development, (Finance) Risk & compliancy, Reporting, Security, Project & Program Management, Information and Data and more

faqs.question: What kind of roles is MACEE recruiting for ?
faqs.answer: MACEE can supply a wide range of people, but our network is mainly focussed on senior-level professionals. These include professionals in positions such as: Business/Information Analyst, Data Engineer, (Cyber) Security Consultant, Testers, Software Developers, Reporting/Finance Specialist and Technical/Functional Project Managers etc.
